column1: # TEST-09 negative-control registry. APPEND-ONLY, one entry per line (M7).
# Columns are TAB separated. Run with: make negative-controls

column5: test-gams is green on the clean tree; if this row fails the runner is measuring a broken tree, not a broken gate

column4: mkdir -p model/build && cd model && gams test/_mutants/gams/always_aborts.gms action=ce o=build/nc_always_aborts.lst scrdir=build lo=0 >/dev/null 2>&1
column5: gams returns rc=3 on abort -- the runner sees a non-zero exit and reports it as expected
the runner itself reddens when an expectation is not met (see task 3)

column4: mkdir -p model/build && printf '# only a comment\n' > model/build/nc_empty.tsv && make negative-controls REGISTRY=model/build/nc_empty.tsv
column5: an emptied registry is a false pass; the runner must refuse it
a payoff unit with a compile error reddens payoff-fixtures (it printed OK before GATE-01)
a glob matching zero units fails instead of reporting a vacuous OK

column4: mkdir -p model/build && cp model/payoff_zero_slippage.gdx model/payoff_band_monotone_large.gdx model/build/ && make payoff-fixtures; rc=$?; cp model/build/payoff_zero_slippage.gdx model/build/payoff_band_monotone_large.gdx model/ ; exit $rc
column5: payoff-fixtures is green on the clean tree, and the committed fixtures are restored so the row leaves no diff
a spec whose gams block does not compile reddens spec-preflight
spec-preflight is green on the committed spec
a spec whose gams block does not compile reddens spec-preflight-band
the Lean leg of spec-preflight-band fails when the submodule is absent (expect=nonzero, not 1: make collapses every recipe failure to its own exit status 2)
spec-preflight-band is green on the committed spec and the initialised submodule
lint-make fails loudly when shellcheck is absent instead of silently skipping
lint-make reddens on a grep-derived predicate in a gating position
lint-make reddens on a compound recipe line that does not declare set -e
lint-make is green over every recipe in Makefile and mk/*.mk
